title: ml_entry_eq refresher latency: pre-screen symbols before the bar closes so only ones that can reach tau on this bar are refreshed and scored at the close (vs the ~15 min full 173-symbol pass)
note: Operator 2026-11-09 ~21:00Z (chat, paraphrased): let the model choose which symbols are worth reviewing before the bar closes; exclude a symbol when the bar about to close could not by itself create entry conditions without more bars closing. CONTEXT: refresher lane (archived 20:36Z) measured decisions landing ~15 min after the 1h close (poll +4 min, pass ~11 min at 173 x ~3.5 s), so real-money entries (alpaca_live ml_entry_eq_struct) price ~15 min later than the backtest's close-of-bar. DESIGN CONSTRAINT (manager): the pre-screen must be CONSERVATIVE, i.e. it may only skip a symbol when no plausible final-bar outcome lifts its score to tau (e.g. score the model at T-5 min on the partial bar, plus a bound on how far one bar can move the prediction from the model's feature sensitivity; keep a margin). Then decisions match the full pass and no new Stage-0 test is needed; verify with a replay that compares pre-screened vs full-pass decisions over the backtest window (target: 0 missed entries). A pre-screen that CAN drop entries the full pass would take is a new filter that needs its own pre-registered net-of-cost test. Compare against the simpler fix: parallel/batched fetch (may make the whole pass ~1-2 min). Measure first: fill vs bar-close slippage on the first ml_entry_eq_struct fills. Post-reset (throttle). (Manager 2026-11-09a) [2026-11-11 ~20:25Z ML lane session_01AFoLuJzKhDBzvqyKJM6emw] MEASURE-FIRST step. (1) Fill vs bar-close slippage CANNOT be measured yet: GET /api/bot/order-packages?strategy=ml_entry_eq_struct&include_paper=true -> count 0 (no package, no fill). ml_entry_eq (paper) has 2 packages: GDX + IWM created 2026-11-09T20:15:37Z / 20:15:49Z for the 20:00Z decision close, i.e. +15.6 / +15.8 min (MEASURED, n=2; consistent with the ~15 min the refresher lane reported). (2) Lag decomposition from src/runtime/ml_entry_eq_refresher.py: SETTLE_S=150 s after the close + up to POLL_S=240 s of poll phase + 173 sequential get_ohlcv(limit=900) calls paced 0.6 s each (~104 s of sleep alone; the measured ~3.5 s per symbol is mostly request latency for 900-bar pages). (3) RECOMMENDATION, not a pre-screen: the 'simpler fix' removes the lag WITHOUT changing a single decision, so it needs no new Stage-0 test. (a) Align the poll to close+SETTLE_S instead of a free-running 240 s poll (saves up to ~4 min). (b) Keep each symbol's frame in memory between passes and fetch only the newest bars, as a MULTI-SYMBOL Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars request (comma-joined symbols, paginated; AlpacaMarketData has no multi-symbol method today, only get_ohlcv per symbol at alpaca_connector.py:176). 173 symbols x a few bars is 1-2 requests, so the pass should take seconds (ESTIMATED, not measured). A pre-screen that can drop entries remains a new filter that needs its own test, as the row says. Both changes are Tier 2 (runtime refresher + connector): prepare as a held PR with a replay asserting byte-identical snapshots, after an operator OK. Also still to do: the slippage read once the first struct fill exists.
